actions.action_type: AES Ohio electric-utility franchise public hearing
actions.exact_result_status: Public hearing scheduled for Ordinance O-7-26, a franchise between Dayton Power and Light Company d/b/a AES Ohio and the City of Piqua to permit AES Ohio to construct, maintain, and operate electric utility facilities within the city. City notice posted August 5, 2026; city update posted August 10, 2026 says AES Ohio and J5 LLC requested amendments adding a $1 million annual customer-paid franchise fee, a 60-day nonpayment cure period, and reducing the initial franchise term from 40 years to 30 years.
actions.access_caveat: Hearing notice and amendment announcement only; no final August 11, 2026 vote result was available during this refresh.
